caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a rectangular top and two drop-leaf extensions on either side, creating a wider surface area. The wood appears in varying shades of brown, capturing the natural grain and texture. The table has four straight, narrow legs, and the two leaves are supported by swing-out supports. The background is a plain, light beige color, giving the composition a neutral setting. There are no other objects or decorations present in the drawing. The artist's signature, "Edna Ral," is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Table, Patrick Henry
